name: Deadly clumps into a unit WITHOUT Tough (#401). Run with --ai-profile tactician. The AI's Melta Team (4x Deadly(3), AP(4) - no save possible at D5) stands on the only objective and shoots YOUR Grunt Squad: five 1-wound Regeneration models. Each clump can only ever kill one grunt, so the Assign Wounds panel should look exactly like a plain volley - '0 / N wounds assigned', no clump strip, no explanation - while the log still shows 'N failed save(s) become clump(s) of 3', a Regeneration roll of 3 dice PER CLUMP (a grunt survives only by ignoring all three), and '... lost - a Deadly clump does not carry over'. Realistic dice, seeded.
